propositions: The differ's comment comparison key is fitted with comment_limits.truncate_comment_body (plain 32,767-char cap) while the Cloud send path fits with AdfCodec.fit_outbound (serialized ADF 32,000 limit), causing the two keys to diverge for over-length comments.
For a 43,200-char body, the differ key returns 32,767 chars while the landed body is 31,753 chars due to marker budget reservation, first diverging at index 31,725.

The body-equality dedup secondary skip is structurally dead for over-length comments because the keys never match, leaving only the ID-based primary skip; a lost map write between add_comment and record_comment_id will re-post every pass.

The divergence was introduced when commit 27b868ba55 moved the send path off the shared truncate_comment_body helper while leaving the differ on it, leaving the two paths with different truncation logic.

The fix restores the shared-fitter invariant by making _JiraSanitizer.fit_comment return fit_comment_as_sent with AdfCodec.fit_outbound injected, so the differ key exactly matches the text the send path lands.
The dedup key is computed in-memory each pass and never persisted, so there is no stored key to migrate; the change can only add dedup skips, never remove them, preventing re-post storms.
